summary: Frontend-only test (mobile 430px, admin@mikilab.de) of the new batch: Academy page + Stripe course purchase + 1-to-1 consultation booking, WhatsApp FAB visibility rule, and EU nutrition table / bold-uppercase allergens on panettone labels. All 5 requested features PASSED. Stripe checkout redirects verified (no payment completed).

issues: The three floating action buttons (Radio, WhatsApp FAB, 'Parla') are vertically centered-low and overlap label/card content (e.g. the WhatsApp FAB covers part of the 'ALLERGENI' line and the 3rd course card title), reducing readability on mobile. Consider moving FABs lower/right or adding side padding.

action_items: Optional: reposition floating FABs so they don't overlap label/allergen text and course card titles on mobile.
critical_code_review_comments: Academy.buy() logged-out path (requireLogin -> auth modal) is effectively unreachable in the UI because login is mandatory at app start; could not be exercised. Backend still enforces auth on /api/academy/checkout (Depends(current_user)), so this is safe.
Academy consultation date input uses a native <input type="date"> (browser default picker) rather than the shadcn calendar component used elsewhere — minor consistency note.
seed_data_creation: Two Stripe test-mode Checkout Sessions were created (1 consult booking 'TEST QA' 2026-08-15, 1 course corso-panettone); neither payment was completed, so academy_orders holds 2 unpaid records for admin@mikilab.de.
